name: More Sparklematic Action
label: Quest
description: More Sparklematic Action: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro. Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!" The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
